stances_toward.note: Rival since Mali recalled its ambassador in Dec 2023 over alleged interference, sharpened by the drone Algeria says it shot down at Tin Zaouatine on 31 Mar 2025 (Mali says inside its territory), the withdrawal of Sahel-alliance ambassadors and Algerian flights to and from Mali suspended in April 2025, Mali's prime minister calling the Algerian regime a sponsor of terrorism and Mali's ICJ case of 4 Sep 2025. Warming: Algeria reopened its airspace and announced its ambassador's return on 10-11 Jul 2026, Mali reciprocated, and Attaf reaffirmed Mali's territorial integrity in April 2026. Rival rather than adversary: neither declares an aim against the other. Bond - affinity: the Sahel alliance itself invokes 'historical and fraternal relations' with Algeria.

stances_toward.note: The model Sahel client: Wagner left on 6-7 Jun 2025 and the Defence Ministry's Africa Corps stayed, about 2,000 men who fight for the junta, abandoned Kidal under attack (Apr 2026), lost a helicopter to Tuareg fire (Jul 2026) and are accused by HRW of killing nine villagers (Aug 2026); equipment now arrives through Lome. Partner on the brief's reading, not ally: no treaty, a transaction of protection for mining and recognition, and a client Moscow can reduce. Burkina Faso (300 men at Loumbila) and Niger (airport defended Feb 2026, coup repelled Aug 2026) are the same relationship and sit in the rows. Bond - none.
